第3章 修为垫底 小心谨慎（第1页）
“郑杰别慌，这少年一身衣衫破碎，衣不蔽体，还有满身血迹，待我带到一旁解开绳索，整理一下。”
“还是沐沐哥想得周到，看少年身形和妙沁阳接近，要不就用沁阳的衣服换上。”景儿仔细打量众人身材后提醒。
待众人看到擦去血污，换了衣衫整理过仪容的少年，面容清秀，高鼻深目，妥妥的一枚小帅哥。
只是小脸上眉头紧皱，看着令人心疼。以云剑尊和嫣然师傅为首的几位美女更是眼眶湿润，心有触动。
“我们此行的目的地是剑门，为了不多生事端，我们继续赶路。”风哥哥率队匆匆向目的地进发。
“郑风疏忽的地方景儿都想到了，真是聪慧。”云剑尊看着景儿给郑杰背上的少年贴上面具，还不忘罩上一个头罩。
“塔灵大哥，你说为什么会这样，这个剑门也太不靠谱，明知道这个附近就是连接下界天元大陆的通道，却没有人接应或是驻扎。”
郑风没顾上景儿给被救少年采取的乔装措施，在和他体内的塔灵沟通。
“你也不想想，天元大陆是个什么地方，几百上千年都没有人满足剑门武君巅峰的接引条件，你总不能让剑门守着一颗千年也不见开花的铁树还兴趣十足，不计得失地坐等花开？”
“谁知道兄弟你这样优秀，让为兄不惜苦等你千年。”塔灵见郑风眉头深锁，知道众人刚进入神界这个陌生的地方，还遇到少年这档子事，郑风思虑太多，不由语气轻松打趣和调侃起来。
“也是，是我自以为是了，天元大陆太贫瘠，武者修为一直和剑门收录弟子的标准有很大的差距，就我这样的也还没有达到剑门外门弟子的录用标准吧？”郑风有些无奈，语气有些失落。但看着一群以他为主心骨的众人，又暗自发誓要勤加努力。
“你也不用妄自菲薄，以你越级挑战的实力，进剑门的外门是没有问题的。”
“只是我要提醒你的是，你小子要考虑的事情，你和景儿入了剑门，外门弟子能否带几位随从？即便能，其余的人员你将如何安置？”郑风被塔灵提醒后，才感觉自己再也不是下界天元大陆的至强者，很多事情要从头做起。
“先说一下，别打‘昊天塔’的主意，到了神界，昊天塔不要轻易动用，你修为虽然这样弱小，脑子一直不笨，怀璧其罪的道理应该懂。”郑风知道自己到了剑门也就是一个外门不起眼的弟子，自己一个外来三无人员，无权无势无背景，还拖家带口，昊天塔还不能用，真是头疼。
在下界郑风一行人可说是叱咤风云，哪用这么辛苦的赶路，即便不乘坐飞行器至少可以坐灵鸢，然而到了神界才发现，一行人都不能飞，飞行器也飞不了。
一问塔灵，说是神界的环境和天元大陆完全不同，一行人来到神界现在都是普通人。
景儿和郑风也只算刚入神界武者的门槛，说白了就是神界垫底的一群人。

说话做事都得十二分的谨慎，一不小心便万劫不复。
好在一群人道心稳固，禁受打击也不颓废，特别是郑风领队的天团少年个个因到达神界欣喜莫名，新环境有挑战就有激情。
郑风知道目前不是考虑这个事情的时候，心头记下，还是引众人远离是非之地，赶路要紧。
行了一夜，东方露出鱼肚白时，一行人还没有走出康庄，为了避人耳目，一行人并没有穿越康庄腹地，而是沿康庄边缘绕行。这样无疑增加了行路的时间。

Chapter 3: Being at the bottom of the cultivation base, be careful (page 1)
"Zheng Jie, don't panic. This young man's clothes are torn, half-clothed, and covered in blood. I will take him aside to untie the rope and tidy him up."
"Brother Mu Mu is still thoughtful. Seeing that the young man's figure is close to that of Miao Qinyang, he might as well change into Qinyang's clothes." Jing'er reminded after carefully looking at everyone's figures.
When everyone saw the young man who had wiped off the blood, changed his clothes and tidied up his appearance, he had a handsome face, a high nose and deep eyes, making him a handsome boy.
There was just a frown on his little face, which made him feel distressed. The beauties headed by Yun Jianzun and Master Yanran had tears in their eyes and their hearts were touched.
"The destination of our trip is Jianmen. In order not to cause too many troubles, we continue on our way." Brother Feng led the team in a hurry towards the destination.
"Jing'er has thought of everything Zheng Feng neglected. He's really smart." Yun Jianzun watched Jing'er put a mask on the boy on Zheng Jie's back, not forgetting to put a hood on it.
"Brother Ta Ling, why do you think this is happening? This Sword Sect is too unreliable. We know that this area is the passage connecting the Tianyuan Continent in the lower realm, but no one is there to respond or station."
Zheng Feng ignored Jing'er's disguise measures for the rescued boy and was communicating with the tower spirit in his body.
"Don't even think about it. What kind of place is Tianyuan Continent? No one in hundreds or even thousands of years has met the requirements for the recruitment of the peak Martial Lord of Jianmen. You can't let Jianmen guard an iron tree that has not bloomed for thousands of years and still be so interested in it that you just sit back and wait for the flowers to bloom regardless of gain or loss?"
"Who knew you were so good, brother, that I would wait for you for thousands of years." Ta Ling saw Zheng Feng's brows furrowed, knowing that everyone had just entered the strange place of the God Realm and encountered such things as a young man. Zheng Feng was thinking too much, so he couldn't help but joke and tease in a light tone.
"Yes, I am self-righteous. The Tianyuan Continent is too barren, and the cultivation level of warriors has always been far from the Jianmen Sect's standards for recruiting disciples. I have not yet met the Jianmen Sect's recruitment standards for the outer disciples, right?" Zheng Feng was a little helpless, and his tone was a little disappointed. But looking at a group of people with him as their backbone, he secretly vowed to work harder.
"You don't have to belittle yourself. With your ability to leapfrog the challenge, there is no problem in entering the outer gate of the Sword Sect."
"I just want to remind you that you have something to consider. When you and Jing'er enter the Sword Sect, can the outer disciples bring a few followers? Even if they can, how will you arrange the rest of the staff?" After Zheng Feng was reminded by the tower spirit, he felt that he was no longer the strongest person in the Tianyuan Continent in the lower world, and many things had to be started from scratch.
"First of all, don't think about the 'Haotian Tower'. When you get to the God Realm, don't use the Haotian Tower easily. Although your cultivation is so weak, your brain has never been stupid. You should understand the reason why you are pregnant with a treasure." Zheng Feng knew that when he arrived at Jianmen, he was just an inconspicuous disciple of the outer sect. He was an outsider with no personnel, no power, no background, and he had a family. The Haotian Tower couldn't be used, which was really a headache.
In the lower realm, Zheng Feng and his group were considered all-powerful. They had to travel so hard. Even if they didn't take the aircraft, they could at least ride on the Ling Yuan. However, when they arrived in the God Realm, they discovered that neither the group nor the aircraft could fly.
When I asked the pagoda spirit, he said that the environment in the God Realm is completely different from that of Tianyuan Continent. The group of people who came to the God Realm are now ordinary people.
Jing'er and Zheng Feng were only on the threshold of becoming warriors in the God Realm. To put it bluntly, they were the bottom group of people in the God Realm.
You have to be extremely cautious in what you say and do. If you are not careful, you will be in jeopardy.
Fortunately, a group of human beings have a stable heart and can withstand blows without giving up. Especially the young men from the Tiantuan group led by Zheng Feng are all inexplicably happy to have arrived in the God Realm, and there are challenges in the new environment.Passion.
Zheng Feng knew that this was not the time to consider this matter, so he made a note in his mind that it was better to lead everyone away from the place of right and wrong and hurry up.
After traveling all night, the group of people had not yet left Kangzhuang when the white fish belly appeared in the east. In order to avoid the eyes and ears of others, the group did not go through the hinterland of Kangzhuang, but detoured along the edge of Kangzhuang. This will undoubtedly increase the travel time.
